document.abstract: It is the purpose of this paper to review data storage technology and to reveal some of the mysteries associated with video disk arrays as related to digital video editing and audio applications. Subjects such as embedded servo, thermal recalibration, mode page settings, head technology, UltraSCSI, Fiber Channel, and 10,000 RPM disk drives are discussed.
